name: tv-out
description: Show the room's TV screen on a wired (HDMI) display: a "Show on wired TV" button that opens the display page in its own window (placed on the second screen in Chrome/Edge), an "Open on another device" link for phone hosts, and a window-side setup (calm look, first-click fullscreen). Separate from the Chromecast kit.
notes: Does not touch or depend on the cast kit. The wired window is the game's normal display page (?room=CODE&role=display) plus &wired=1.

initWiredWindow() (call once in main.tsx) adds the same `cast` class the Chromecast page uses, so the existing animations-off CSS applies, and arms a first-click fullscreen (which also unlocks sound).
